author: Jay
name: ContainerStatus
short: Live Discord status cards for any Docker container, read from Arcane.
description: Posts a card for a Docker container in a channel and keeps editing it: a 🟢 / 🟠 / 🔴 dot for up, starting or restarting, and down, how long it has been up, an optional description and an optional link to open the service. Cards can come from any Arcane environment. The bot only reads container status from Arcane's API; it can't start, stop or change anything. Cards are only updated while the bot is running.
install_msg: In Arcane, make a key whose role only has containers:list and containers:read (add environments:list to use more than one environment). DM the bot: [p]set api arcane url <arcane url> api_key <key>. Check it with [p]containercard show, then post a card with [p]containercard add #channel <container> [title]. [p]containercard containers lists the container names in every environment; use name@environment for one outside the default.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no data about users.
